newsitem.title: USA: FINAL PRICING -- Pima County IDA, Ariz..
newsitem.headline: FINAL PRICING -- Pima County IDA, Ariz..

text.p: WE EXPECT TO RECEIVE THE WRITTEN AWARD THIS AFTERNOON. CUSIP
WIRE WILL BE SENT AT THAT TIME.
THE PREMIUM TERM BONDS DUE NOVEMBER 1, 2029 ARE SUBJECT TO
OPTIONAL REDEMPTION IN WHOLE OR IN PART AT ANY TIME ON OR
UPON THE ORIGINAL ISSUE PRICE, INCLUDING ORIGINAL ISSUE
PREMIUM, AMORTIZED TO PAR ON THE DATE OF THE FINAL REDEMPTION
FROM PREPAYMENTS AND EXCESS REVENUES ASSUMING A PREPAYMENT
RATE 100% OF THE PSA PREPAYMENT MODEL, PLUS A REDEMPTION
PREMIUM OF 2% OF THE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT ON MAY 1, 2007 DECLINING
1% PER YEAR TO NO PREMIUM MAY 1, 2009 AND THEREAFTER.
MANDATORY TENDER: ALL TERM BONDS ARE SUBJECT TO MANDATORY
TENDER, AT THE OPTION OF THE AUTHORITY, AT ANY TIME IN WHOLE
OR IN PART ON JANUARY 1, 1998 AND ON THE FIRST DAY OF EACH
MONTH THEREAFTER TO AND INCLUDING AUGUST 1, 1998. APPLIES TO
UNEXPENDED PROCEEDS ONLY; THE INTEREST RATE TO BE BORNE BY NEW
MORTGAGE LOANS MUST BE AT LEAST 0.50% LESS THAN THE PRESENT
LOAN RATE. (SEE PRELIMINARY OFFICIAL STATEMENT FOR ADDITIONAL
EXPECTED AVERAGE LIVES BASED ON 100% PSA EXPERIENCE:
AVERAGE LIFE BASED ON 100% PSA EXPERIENCE 3.976 YEARS

MONTH THEREAFTER TO AND INCLUDING AUGUST 1, 1998. APPLIES TO
UNEXPENDED PROCEEDS ONLY; THE INTEREST RATE TO BE BORNE BY NEW
